# TamilDev

> TamilDev is a free, realtime developer community for Tamil-speaking engineers. Frontend, backend, mobile and AI developers learn together, get live code reviews in architecture clinics, join skill cohorts, and ship production-grade open-source projects.

## About

TamilDev (தமிழ்Dev) is a developer community founded in 2021. Members master and deploy a curated stack of modern web, mobile, database and artificial intelligence tools. Key activities include:

- Architecture Clinic — live code reviews of repos, schemas and design specs
- Skill Cohorts — hands-on sprints that ship real applications
- Dev Partnerships — matchmaking between startups and contract engineers
- Engineering Circle — peer discussions on architecture, deployments and local AI workflows

## Tech stack

React, React Native, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Kubernetes, Claude AI, Ollama, Luma API.
